worldcombat.skill.spotlight.summary: Pin a beam of light on any creature: while lit it takes more damage from every source and becomes the centre of attention - creatures around it that are hostile to it are drawn onto it. Light an enemy to mark the team's focus-fire target; light an ally to pull nearby enemies onto it, at the cost of it taking more damage too. It needs a visible creature target, cannot be fired at empty space, and the light has a time limit.
worldcombat.skill.spotlight.use.1: Expose it before the team opens up
worldcombat.skill.spotlight.use.2: Light a sturdy ally and pull nearby enemies onto it
The lit creature takes %1$s%% more damage from all sources for %2$s s; it ends when the time is up or earlier if the effect is removed.

Cast reach is about %1$s blocks. While lit, creatures within about %2$s blocks of it that are hostile to it are pointed at it - it becomes the centre of attention. Light an enemy to mark the team's focus-fire target; light an ally to pull fire onto it, at the cost of it taking more damage too. Empty space does nothing; it needs a visible creature target.
Preparation %1$s s, recovery %2$s s, cooldown %3$s s from cast.
worldcombat.skill.spotlight.stance.pierc: Pierce: exposure x1.4 but the light lasts only 70%% as long - make an opening and strike while it is bright.
worldcombat.skill.spotlight.stance.pin: Pin: exposure x0.75 but the light lasts 1.3x as long - hold the foe in the spotlight.
worldcombat.skill.spotlight.timing: Cast on any creature. After %1$s s of preparation it spends %3$s PP, recovers %2$s s, and commits a %4$s s cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.spotlight.preference.m: Pierce: exposure x1.4, light x0.7, made for opening a target before focus fire. Pin: exposure x0.75, light x1.3, made to hold a foe in the spotlight. Strength and duration trade off.
worldcombat.skill.spotlight.preference.a: Only shine on a threat within this distance; lower stays close, higher marks a target from farther away.
Only prioritise the spotlight once this many allies (including yourself) are gathered near the target; 1 shines on sight, higher only when focus fire is real.
On, a companion holding its station will step out to shine the light.
On, when a fragile ally is threatened nearby, shine the light on a sturdier ally to pull fire onto it; off, only mark enemies as the focus-fire target.
An ally below this health fraction counts as needing protection; higher is quicker to draw fire for others, lower only when they are nearly down.
Only an ally at or above this health fraction is chosen to draw fire; higher keeps the extra damage on healthier allies, lower lets wounded ones draw fire too.
